mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, we are looking at 64 degrees with overcast conditions at Verona Community Park and a first quarter moon overhead, while tonight will reach a low of 57 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona is inviting residents to subscribe to their digital newsletter to stay informed on local projects, while the police department has announced they are currently hiring new patrol officers to join their team.

Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, and starting Friday, the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival kicks off in Paoli followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market on the Square.
In a noteworthy update, on September 5, police responded to reports of local vehicles being targeted with cheese slices on their windshields as part of a social media trend.
Culver's of Verona is now closed for the evening, but we look forward to serving you again tomorrow when we open at 10 AM with a fresh flavor of the day.
